results.title: Cloaked Reviews (2026) | Product Hunt
results.content:
It feels just wow! Is it really that easy? It's the first application that could make the anonymous registration process so easy for the user. Phone numbers are generated instantly. It's easy to customize your digital life so that for every website, service, user has a cloaked phone number and email address. All sms and emails go to my real phone number and my email. But this can be opted out of through the settings if desired. The app also makes it easy to import all user passwords, there's even a two-factor authentication field. The design is as modern as possible. What is important for such an application is the smooth operation. Here I can say that I have not had a single failure, all sms came, e-mails were received and sent. This is high quality and excellent approach to the [...] Cloaked is the password and identity service you wish was integrated into every piece of tech you've engaged with since the first time you made a login. I don't ever want to remember a password or use my real email or phone # again, and that's just the start here. Cloaked makes using devices much easier -- it's a keychain that's under lock and key, but only you as the user have access to that one key and lock. It also makes it so much easier to use new devices, and it's so reassuring to know the amount of eyes/servers touching any real information about you is constantly going down as you replace your online identities and thus your digital footprint. Full disclosure is that I've been an (unpaid) Cloaked Beta tester and upon their first paid rollout subscribed to the product. I see myself [...] Thibault Milan

results.title: Unpluq Reviews (2026) | Product Hunt
results.content:
A wonderful way to ensure that you curb your habit of picking up your phone dozens of times a day. This wonderful approach allows you to keep your tech but also build healthy habits. Also, an excellent tool to create a little bit of a barrier for youth and young adults that may still need assistance. For many, just requiring the user to get a fob to touch to the phone is just what they need to think twice about what they are doing. For those who are facing more serious dependency, the fob and codes can be given to a trusted friend or parent that can help hold them responsible until they are ready. Even for the average professional who simply wants to be left alone for part of the day to concentrate, this is an amazing and refreshing way to create more contemplative and productive moments [...] Based on 22 reviews

Review Unpluq?

Reviewers describe Unpluq as an easy, effective way to cut distraction, especially for people who want a “dumb phone” feel without losing smartphone access. Users repeatedly say it helps them spend less time on social media and other compulsive apps, stay focused, and feel more present in conversations and daily life. The physical barrier and thoughtful tag design stand out as the key difference from app-only screen-time tools. The only clear drawback mentioned is that iOS screen-time permissions can be disabled too easily, which weakens the lock.

results.title: Cipherwill: Ensure your data reaches your loved ones when you pass away. | Product Hunt
results.content:
Maker

📌

Most people don’t think about what happens to their digital stuff after they’re gone - until it’s too late. A friend passed away last year with crypto, domains, and a YouTube channel, and his family couldn’t access any of it. That’s where the idea for Cipherwill came from.  
  
So built to ensure your digital life - crypto keys, bank accounts, passwords, investments, files - can be securely stored and automatically passed on to your people if something happens to you. It’s fully end-to-end encrypted (not even we can access it), and designed to be dead simple to use ⚡  
  
There are tools out there for legal wills, but no one’s solving the actual problem of digital assets getting lost forever. We’re trying to fix that.  
  
Happy to answer anything or get your thoughts 🙌
